zh.summary: 完善插件运行状态、独立恢复入口和 Windows 窗口模式选择。
highlights: 插件开关与实际运行状态不一致时显示原因，并提供重启后确认入口。
独立恢复程序可以检查、暂停及恢复故障启动插件，保留插件文件、配置与会话。
Windows 视图菜单增加保留任务栏的最大化或还原入口，并明确区分 F11 全屏。
为锁定的 alpha.1 内核补充历史 descriptor v2 只读迁移；继续使用官方格式校验、会话执行和保存机制。
knownIssues: 未验证物理断电恢复；历史会话验收使用隔离测试数据，不代表所有用户历史数据均已验证。
upgradeNotes: 本版保持 DSH 0.1.7-alpha.1 与正式默认插件组合；RC 内核仍独立验收，不混入正式升级。

en.summary: Improve plugin runtime status, independent recovery and Windows window-mode choices.
highlights: Explain mismatches between a plugin switch and its runtime state, with an action to restart and check again.
Inspect, pause and restore faulty startup plugins from the independent recovery program while retaining plugin files, settings and sessions.
Add a maximize-or-restore action to the Windows View menu and distinguish it from F11 fullscreen.
Add a narrowly scoped read migration for historical descriptor-v2 sessions on the pinned alpha.1 core, retaining official validation, execution and persistence.
knownIssues: Physical power-loss recovery is not qualified. Historical-session acceptance uses isolated fixtures and does not cover every user history.
upgradeNotes: Retain DSH 0.1.7-alpha.1 and stable default plugins. RC cores remain separately qualified and are not mixed into this stable upgrade.
